data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to show, hide, or defer the iPhone home indicator.
data.what_it_does: Allows showing, hiding, or checking the status of the iPhone home indicator. Also supports deferring screen edges to require a second swipe.
use_when: You need to hide the home indicator on iPhones for full-screen immersive content
You want to grey out the home indicator by deferring screen edges
avoid_when: You are building primarily for Android where this plugin does nothing
strengths: Simple API for home indicator control
weaknesses: Home indicator still shows up when user gestures near the bottom of the screen on iOS
